name: VARoleInterpreterPreschoolEnrollmentPacket

custom.system_prompt: Dana and Omar, having chosen a preschool, now face a dense enrollment packet full of policies, forms, and dates. They ask Sigma to help them figure out what applies to their family and what's actually due when. Sigma clarifies without deciding anything for them.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Kitchen table, evening, papers shuffling, faint kids' voices

initial_prompt: Generate a scene where Dana and Omar, having chosen a preschool for their child, face a dense enrollment packet full of policies, required forms, and multiple dates. They ask Sigma to help them figure out what applies to their family and what's actually due when. Sigma organizes the packet into what needs to be submitted, by when, and what's just informational, based on the actual document. Keep every line short and natural.

variations.context: Parents working through a dense preschool enrollment packet with multiple forms and dates

setting.mood: Practical, wanting to get this organized without missing anything
setting.relationship_dynamic: Couple working through a shared document together, then involving Sigma
setting.background: The packet has at least four different dates mentioned across different sections, not clearly prioritized
setting.conversation_style: Short, collaborative exchanges, both contributing what they notice in the packet

scenario_template.topic: Dana and Omar each notice different parts of the packet, agreeing it's more complicated than they expected. A couple of short lines.
scenario_template.note: Both contribute observations about the packet's complexity.

scenario_template.topic: Dana asks Sigma to help them figure out what's actually required and by when, addressing Sigma directly in one short line.
scenario_template.note: e.g. 'Sigma, this enrollment packet has forms and dates everywhere. Help us figure out what we actually need to do.'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma asks them to read out the required forms and every date mentioned in the packet, so it has the actual content to organize.
scenario_template.note: Both partners contribute, reading different sections.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma organizes the packet into what forms need submitting, which of the several dates is the actual enrollment deadline versus informational dates like the first day of class, based on the actual document.
scenario_template.note: This should reference their specific packet's forms and dates.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma identifies the single nearest actionable deadline among everything mentioned, so they know what to prioritize first.
scenario_template.note: One clear priority surfaced from several dates.

scenario_template.topic: Dana and Omar agree on who will handle which form, relieved to have an actual checklist. Keep this realistic — a little daunted by the volume still.
scenario_template.mood: Organized, mildly daunted by the volume

variations.context: Parents navigating a preschool packet with variable schedules

setting.relationship_dynamic: Couple working through a shared document together, then involving Sigma
setting.background: The packet includes diverse weekly schedules and optional program choices.
setting.conversation_style: Short, collaborative exchanges, both contributing what they notice in the packet

scenario_template.topic: They realize the packet is filled with varied program schedules, feeling a bit lost.
scenario_template.note: Convey their surprise at the complexity.

scenario_template.topic: One of them asks Sigma to help make sense of the program options and deadlines.
Sigma prompts them to list programs and dates from the packet.
scenario_template.note: Sigma engages them to gather necessary details.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma categorizes mandatory programs and notes optional ones.
scenario_template.note: Sigma should clarify mandatory vs. optional choices.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma points out the closest deadline for mandatory program decisions.
scenario_template.note: Highlight the key date to focus on.

scenario_template.topic: They divide tasks for deciding on program choices, feeling more organized.

variations.context: Parents dealing with preschool forms involving health requirements

setting.relationship_dynamic: Couple working through a shared document together, then involving Sigma
setting.background: The packet contains several health-related forms and vaccination schedules.
setting.conversation_style: Short, collaborative exchanges, both contributing what they notice in the packet

scenario_template.topic: They note a confusing mix of health form requirements and vaccination deadlines.
scenario_template.note: Capture their bewilderment with the health-related requirements.

scenario_template.topic: One of them seeks Sigma's help to untangle the health paperwork deadlines.
scenario_template.note: Clear and concise request to Sigma.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma asks for a list of health forms and related dates to better assist them.
scenario_template.note: Sigma facilitates by asking for specific information.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma segregates health forms by urgency and vaccination deadlines.
scenario_template.note: Focus on distinguishing immediate from long-term requirements.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma points out the nearest health paperwork submission date.
scenario_template.note: Focus on the urgency of this particular deadline.

scenario_template.topic: They split the health tasks, aiming to complete them in time, feeling reassured.
scenario_template.note: Show their relief but awareness of the task volume.

user1.name: Dana
user1.role: Practical physical therapist and mother of two, working through a dense preschool enrollment packet with her partner. Speaks in short sentences. Wants an organized checklist above all.

user2.name: Omar
user2.role: Warm high school teacher, reading through the preschool enrollment packet carefully alongside his partner. Speaks in short sentences. Relieved by the organized breakdown but a little daunted by the volume of paperwork.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Interpreter. Organizes a dense enrollment packet into required forms, actionable deadlines, and informational dates, based on the actual document. Identifies the single nearest priority. Does not decide anything on the family's behalf.

conversation_structure: The couple's reading is collaborative, each contributing different parts of the packet
Sigma asks for the actual forms and dates rather than assuming generic packet content
Sigma distinguishes actionable deadlines from informational dates and identifies the single nearest priority
Every line is one or two short spoken sentences
The resolution is an organized checklist, with realistic mild overwhelm at the volume of paperwork
assistant_behavior: Sigma works from the actual packet's specific forms and dates
Sigma prioritizes rather than just listing everything with equal weight
